description: A meter bridge, also known as a slide wire bridge, is a simple and effective instrument used for measuring electrical resistance in a circuit. It consists of a one-meter-long wire mounted on a wooden or metallic base. The wire is usually made of a material with high electrical conductivity, such as constantan.  The meter bridge operates on the principle of a Wheatstone bridge, which balances the unknown resistance with a known resistance to determine the unknown resistance value. The bridge has a one-meter-long wire with a sliding jockey that can be moved along its length. A galvanometer is connected across the wire, and a known resistance is connected in series with the unknown resistance.  By adjusting the position of the sliding jockey along the wire, the bridge is balanced when the galvanometer shows zero deflection. At this point, the ratio of the lengths of the wire on either side of the jockey is proportional to the ratio of the unknown resistance to the known resistance. This allows for the calculation of the unknown resistance based on the length of wire on either side of the jockey.  The meter bridge is a versatile tool used in physics laboratories for educational purposes and practical experiments involving electrical circuits and resistance measurements.

description:
Digital pH meter:
Digital pH meter is a scientific instrument that measures the hydrogen-ion activity in water-based solutions, indicating its acidity or alkalinity expressed as pH. The difference in electrical potential relates to the acidity or pH of the solution.

 A pH meter  takes advantage of this and works like a voltmeter: it measures the voltage  produced by the solution whose acidity we're interested in, compares it with the voltage of a known solution, and uses the difference in voltage.

description: A centrifuge is a piece of equipment that is commonly found in scientific laboratories. Centrifuges use centrifugal force to separate substances of different densities. They work by spinning a sample at high speed, causing the denser particles to move to the bottom of the container, while the less dense particles remain at the top. Centrifuges can be used for a variety of purposes, such as separating blood components or isolating DNA. There are many different types of centrifuges, ranging from small tabletop models to large floor-standing models.

description:
Cette espèce de cocotte-minute haute sur pattes, installée dans le labo d'un producteur de foie gras artisanal des environs de Bressuire (79), est en fait un autoclave de marque Techna.
Ustensile utilisé pour stériliser, à l'eau bouillante d'une température de 120°C, les bocaux en verre ou encore conserves métalliques avant remplissage et scellement. Ceci génère une vapeur saturée avec pression dépassant 150 kPa. Un cycle complet dure une demi-heure.
Le principal risque en sécurité alimentaire étant le botulisme, responsable encore aujourd'hui de nombreuses intoxications à travers le monde.
Tous les aliments ou presque sont concernés : charcuteries et viandes, fruits, légumes, poissons etc.
La cuve de l'appareil présente une contenance de 95 l, ce qui permet d'y placer plus ou moins 55 pots ou boites type 4/4 - Ø 99 x h. 118 mm
Munie de ses accessoires l'installation, alimentée électriquement en 380 V triphasé, atteint le poids respectable de 110 kg.

Mais pour préparer les confitures maison aucun souci, vous pouvez toujours utiliser une bonne vieille cocotte du commerce !
